subject: Audit request: CI/CD and deployment integrity evidence
messages:
From: Neil Saunders <neil@sigma-assess.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Cc: security@finservco.com
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG/SOC2: CI/CD & deploy controls evidence request

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. As part of FinServCo's SIG intake we're collecting concrete evidence for the following SDLC items: PR gating (code review policy + coverage), CI run history for an example deploy, secrets handling during CI/CD (how short-lived tokens are issued and rotated), and deploy approval logs for production rollouts.

Could you please provide: 1) an example CI pipeline execution log for a production deploy; 2) the current code review policy and reviewer distribution metrics; 3) the procedure for issuing ephemeral deploy tokens (and a recent rotation record); and 4) the audit trail for a recent manual prod approval. PDFs or zips are fine.

We'd like the artifacts by EOD tomorrow if possible — our assessor will include them in the SIG review packet. If any of these are covered by a different team, please loop them in.

Best,
Neil
Sigma Assessments
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Neil Saunders <neil@sigma-assess.com>
Cc: security@finservco.com
Date: 2027-05-03T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/SOC2: CI/CD & deploy controls evidence request

Hi Neil — thanks, we can provide those. I'm pulling artifacts now and will coordinate internally for the detailed provenance records. A couple quick notes so the items are scoped correctly:

- Example CI run: we'll attach the pipeline logs for the May 2 production deployment (sanitized for any ephemeral secrets).
- Code review: sending our PR gating policy (v1.3) plus reviewer coverage export for Q1.
- Secrets: our CI uses Vault-issued short-lived tokens for deploys; we'll include the rotation runbook and a recent token issuance audit (redacted).
- Approvals: we'll include the deploy-authorization audit trail (who approved, timestamp, job ids).

I'll send a bundle in the next few hours. If you need raw logs rather than the packaged zip let me know.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Head of Platform Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: security@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG/SOC2: CI/CD & deploy controls evidence request

Team — forwarding Neil's ask from FinServCo (see below). They want the CI run log, PR review metrics, ephemeral token rotation evidence, and the prod approval trail. Can each of you own the artifact bits below and reply with the exact files we can hand over by EOD tomorrow.

Soojin: PR gating policy + reviewer coverage export (Q1). Any sensitive PR comments should be redacted; we only need metadata and diffs.
Vivek: pipeline logs for 2027-05-02 production deploy (sanitize env vars). Include job ids and step timing.
Rishi: Vault/secret issuance & rotation procedure and the audit record for a token issued during that deploy; include KMS key usage logs if possible.

If there are any blockers (legal, export controls, or third-party creds), flag immediately. I'll assemble and deliver to Neil.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: security@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG/SOC2: CI/CD & deploy controls evidence request

Camila — attaching the items I have ready. See attachments: pr_review_coverage_2027Q1.csv and deploy-policy-v1.3.pdf.

Notes: our PR gating requires two reviewers for changes touching infra, one for app-level changes. The coverage export includes reviewer id distribution (redacted to employee ids), average time-to-merge, and PR size buckets. We redact CI logs for third-party tokens per our policy.

I'll coordinate with Vivek for linking the pipeline job ids to the PR numbers.

- Soojin
Director, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pr_review_coverage_2027Q1.csv (CSV), deploy-policy-v1.3.pdf (PDF)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: security@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG/SOC2: CI/CD & deploy controls evidence request

Camila — packaging and attaching the pipeline evidence now. Attached: ci_pipeline_run_20270502.log and deploy-authorization-audit-trail.zip.

Notes on sanitization: we stripped environment secrets and replaced any ephemeral token values with token placeholders. The pipeline log includes job ids (job_8347), step timings, docker image digests, and the deployment playbook reference. The audit-zip contains the approval records from our internal approvals service (user ids and timestamps) and the step that triggered the prod rollout.

I'll hand off to Rishi for the Vault issuance audit; he has the issuance record and rotation notes.

- Vivek
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

Attachments: ci_pipeline_run_20270502.log (plain text), deploy-authorization-audit-trail.zip (zip)
From: Neil Saunders <neil@sigma-assess.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Cc: security@finservco.com
Date: 2027-05-04T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/SOC2: CI/CD & deploy controls evidence request

Camila,

This is great, thank you. We received the policy PDF, the reviewer coverage CSV, the pipeline log, and the approval audit bundle. A couple of follow-ups from the assessor:

1) Can you also provide a short note or artifact showing the mechanism that ensures ephemeral tokens cannot be replayed after rotation (e.g., token revocation, one-time use markers, or TTL enforcement in Vault)?
2) For the deploy authorization trail, could you include the internal ticket/PR link that ties the approval to a change request (a single canonical link is enough).

If you can drop those two items by EOD Friday that will close the open gaps. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Neil
Sigma Assessments
